title: Prime Day Is Here—These Are the Deals Worth Buying
gist: Wired's master Prime Day (Oct 6-7, 2026) deals list across Apple, Kindle, audio, smart home, laptops, phones and more; the useful signal is repeated price hikes by Apple and Amazon in 2026 and tight Mac Mini supply driven by local agentic-AI demand, with most deals being modest.

insights.claim: Apple raised prices across Macs and iPads earlier in 2026, so most iPad deals disappeared; the 11-inch iPad (A16) at $399 is called one of the only iPad deals that survived Apple's price hikes.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Hardware vendors are passing cost increases to consumers; discounts are partly restoring prior prices rather than cutting them.

insights.claim: Amazon raised prices on Echo and Kindle devices at the end of August 2026 (Echo Dot from $50 to $80, Kindle Colorsoft base to $290 from $250), so some Prime Day 'discounts' are effectively smaller than headline.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Amazon devices pricing power is rising; headline Prime Day percentages overstate real savings.

insights.claim: The MacBook Air M5 at $1,099 (15% off, lowest since June) is Wired's top deal and its most-recommended laptop despite prices rising considerably over the past year.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Mac demand holds at higher price points; discounting by retailers rather than Apple.
insights.locator: This MacBook Sale Is the Best Prime Day Deal

insights.claim: The Mac Mini was sold out for most of 2026 due to rapid escalation in interest in using them as local, agentic AI machines, and the new M6 model at $780 is a rare discount.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Local agentic AI is creating real consumer hardware demand for Apple silicon, a read-through for Apple.
insights.quote: The Mac Mini has been sold out for the majority of this year due to the rapid escalation of interest in using them as local, agentic AI machines.

insights.claim: Bose is phasing out QuietComfort Headphones (1st Gen) for the 2nd Gen and launched a new Ultra Open Earbuds version, leading to 53% and 33% discounts on prior models.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Launch cycles drive clearance pricing of outgoing products.

insights.claim: Apple AirPods Pro 3 at $179 (28% off) and AirPods Max 2 at $429 (22% off) are the best iPhone-user audio picks, with AirPods Pro 3 featuring heart-rate sensors and live translation.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Apple health-sensor features are moving into earbuds.
insights.locator: The Best AirPods At the Best Price

insights.claim: Samsung Galaxy S26 was discounted 25% to $900 and S26+ 30% to $980 on Amazon.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Deep early discounts on flagship Android phones suggest competitive pressure.
insights.locator: Great Android Phones Are on Sale

insights.claim: Wired notes that Arlo's Pro 6 security camera requires a pricey subscription of $10 per month for subject recognition and cloud storage, illustrating subscription lock-in in smart home hardware.
insights.speaker: Louryn Strampe
insights.so_what: Recurring revenue attached to hardware, as with Skylight, Birdfy AI ID ($54/year).
insights.locator: Great Discounts On Our Favorite Security Cameras
